summary: Tests cover core functionality (parsing XML/JSON, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown rendering) but miss direct testing of ConvertTo-NormalizedStatus and many edge cases (unicode, special characters, invalid durations, empty names). Critical design flaw: TestResultsAggregator.Tests.ps1 references fixture files (fixtures/run1-junit.xml, run2-junit.xml, run3-results.json) without creating them in setup—tests assume pre-committed fixtures exist, violating test isolation. Workflow.Tests.ps1 requires external dependencies (powershell-yaml module, actionlint CLI) not created during test setup. Would catch regressions in happy paths but is fragile due to fixture dependency and incomplete edge case coverage.
